name: Cellular stress response and mitochondrial apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate cellular responses to drug, antibiotic, hypoxic, oxidative and osmotic stress; mitochondrial depolarization and apoptosis set it apart from respiration/ATP and ethanol/anesthetic neighbours.

name: Chaperone-mediated protein folding and refolding
rationale: All members concern chaperonin (CCT/TriC, prefoldin) and chaperone folding of actin, tubulin and ER proteins, unlike neighbours centred on tubulin modification or telomerase assembly.

name: Neuronal immunoglobulin-superfamily adhesion and nodal sodium channel clustering
rationale: Members are L1, NrCAM, neurofascin, CHL1, DSCAM, SDK and nectin adhesion with axonal sodium channel clustering and paranodal assembly, which repulsion, NCAM and myelination neighbours lack.

name: RAS-family GTPase activation of RAF-MAPK signaling
rationale: Members cover SOS, MRAS-SHOC2, RIT/RIN and RAF/MEK/RSK activation, distinguishing them from neighbours about RAS GAPs and ERK negative feedback.

name: Rho activation by Galpha12/13 GPCRs and Sema4D-plexin-B
rationale: Members concern Rho activation via G12/13-coupled receptors and Sema4D/RND1 plexin-B signaling, unlike Sema3A axon-repulsion neighbours.

core: Suppression of effector T cell responses
name: Treg differentiation and suppression of effector T cell responses
rationale: Members promote regulatory T cells and inhibit T cell proliferation, IL-2, IFN-gamma, Th1 and Th17 responses, unlike tolerance/anergy or Th1-promoting neighbours.

name: Skeletal myofiber differentiation and postsynaptic neuromuscular junction assembly
rationale: Members span myogenesis, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex and AChR clustering at the NMJ, unlike presynaptic cholinergic or basement-membrane neighbours.

name: Base, nucleotide and mismatch excision repair with translesion synthesis
rationale: Members are BER, NER, MMR, alkylation reversal, crosslink repair and translesion/repair synthesis, lacking the double-strand-break and homologous recombination repair of neighbours.

name: Nucleotide and deoxynucleotide catabolism including thiopurine drugs
rationale: Members degrade pyrimidine and (deoxy)nucleotides and triphosphates (NUDT sanitization, TPMT/azathioprine), unlike biosynthetic or antiviral-drug neighbours.

name: Vocal learning, auditory response and striatal development
rationale: Members concern vocalization, vocal and observational learning, auditory and mechanosensory behavior and striatum development, unlike motor, social or cerebellar neighbours.

name: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation by myeloid cells
rationale: Members are MHC class II and CD1 lipid presentation, NKT regulation and dendritic cell/monocyte signatures, unlike MHC class I cross-presentation neighbours.

name: Iron and heme uptake, transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern transferrin, ferroportin, DMT1, ceruloplasmin and heme transport and iron homeostasis, unlike copper/manganese, oxygen-transport and scavenger-receptor neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification and RNA import
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification, 5'-leader removal and RNA import, unlike mitochondrial rRNA/ribosome or nuclear tRNA neighbours.

name: Locomotor behavior, sensorimotor gating and glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission
rationale: Members include locomotion, exploration, grooming, prepulse inhibition and nonassociative learning plus enhanced glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, which vocal, cerebellar and touch neighbours lack.

name: Deubiquitinase control of protein stability and proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members are UCH and USP deubiquitinases and regulation of proteasomal catabolism and protein destabilization, unlike chain-linkage, proteasome-assembly and quality-control neighbours.

name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored targeting and insertion into the ER and COPII cargo export to Golgi, unlike COPI retrograde and ER quality-control neighbours.

name: Epithelial adherens junction and apical-basal polarity maintenance
rationale: Members concern cadherin adherens junctions, apical-basal polarity, apical constriction and EMT restraint, unlike desmosome, CDH1-trafficking and endothelial neighbours.

name: GPI anchor biosynthesis and UDP-N-acetylglucosamine synthesis
rationale: Members are GPI synthesis and attachment plus UDP-GlcNAc synthesis via GFPT1, unlike N-glycosylation/dolichol and sialic acid neighbours.

name: Cholesterol efflux, reverse transport and foam cell suppression
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, HDL and apoA-I, LXR-driven transport and sterol homeostasis with inhibition of foam cells, unlike SREBP biosynthesis or lipoprotein remodeling neighbours.

name: Vascular smooth muscle differentiation and vessel remodeling
rationale: Members concern VSMC development, differentiation, dedifferentiation and blood vessel remodeling, unlike VSMC proliferation/migration or endothelial neighbours.

name: Dopamine synthesis and dopamine transporter-mediated reuptake
rationale: Members concern dopamine biosynthesis, DAT (SLC6A3) catecholamine uptake and transmitter release control, unlike norepinephrine-transport and dopamine-receptor neighbours.

name: Host transcriptional control of viral latency and endogenous retroelements
rationale: Members concern host activation/suppression of viral transcription, HCMV latency and KRAB-ZFP/HUSH silencing of retroelements, unlike HIV replication-cycle neighbours.

name: Regulation of PTEN localization, stability and translation
rationale: Members concern PTEN localization, stability, ceRNA/lncRNA control and loss in cancer, unlike AKT-target and PI3K-inhibition neighbours.

name: TLR7/8/9-IRF signaling and type I interferon production
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR7/8/9 signaling via IRF5/IRF7 and nucleic-acid-sensing induction of IFN-alpha/beta, unlike cGAS-STING and TLR3 neighbours.

name: APC/C-mediated ubiquitination controlling anaphase and mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern APC/C regulation, Emi1, K11-linked ubiquitination and substrate degradation at metaphase-anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike cohesion, spindle or G1/S neighbours.
